title: ida fimbriata
intro: Ida fimbriata, commonly known as Kalmegh or Indian Pyrethrum, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions, including fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The health benefits of Ida fimbriata include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing fever, alleviating digestive discomfort, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Ida fimbriata include sesquiterpene lactones, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
